cards.name: Shield Bash
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If the attack deals damage, you may move that Enemy to a connected Location.
cards.flavor: A shield is more than protection—it is a weapon in disciplined hands.

cards.name: Longsword Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If this attack defeats the target, you may move to a connected Location.
cards.flavor: Every strike should leave you in a stronger position than before.

cards.name: Defensive Slash
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. Until the start of your next turn, increase your armor by 1.
cards.flavor: The safest strike is one that leaves no opening.

cards.name: Pommel Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If this attack deals damage, the target gains Stunned until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: A battle isn't won by the strongest blow—but by the one that leaves your enemy unable to answer.

cards.name: Driving Assault
cards.rules: Move to a connected Location. Then make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If the attack deals damage, you may move that Enemy to a connected Location.
cards.flavor: When the line must advance, Aldric is the first to step forward.

cards.name: Shield Charge
cards.rules: Move to a connected Location. Then make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If the attack deals damage: Move the target to a connected Location. You may immediately move to the Location the target left.
cards.flavor: A disciplined charge breaks the enemy's resolve before the sword is ever drawn.

cards.name: Raise Shield
cards.rules: Play when you are targeted by an Attack. Increase your armor by 2 for this Attack. After the Attack is resolved, discard this card.
cards.flavor: The best defense is the one your enemy never expected.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.rules: Until the start of your next turn: Increase your armor by 1. Enemies cannot voluntarily leave your Location unless they first attack you or another card allows them to do so. The first time each Enemy leaves your Location this turn, you may immediately make a basic Attack against that Enemy.
cards.flavor: No foe passes while I still stand.

cards.name: Interpose
cards.rules: Play when another Hero in your Location is targeted by an Attack. You become the target of that Attack instead. Before resolving the Attack, increase your armor by 1.
cards.flavor: Stand behind me.

cards.name: Brace
cards.rules: Play when you are targeted by an Attack. For this Attack: Increase your Armor by 3. If the Attack deals more than 2 damage, you may immediately make a basic Attack against the attacker. After resolving this card, discard it.
cards.flavor: A steadfast shield turns an enemy's greatest blow into their greatest mistake.

cards.name: Unyielding Stand
cards.rules: Until the start of your next turn: Increase your armor by 2. Heroes in your Location increase their armor by 1. Whenever another Hero in your Location is targeted by an Attack, you may become the target instead
cards.flavor: The line does not break while I still draw breath.

cards.name: Rally
cards.rules: Choose up to 2 Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero gains Inspired until the start of your next turn. If a chosen Hero is Stunned, remove Stunned instead of gaining Inspired.
cards.flavor: Stand together. We finish this as one.

cards.name: Coordinated Strike
cards.rules: Choose one allied Hero within 2 connected Locations. That Hero may immediately make a basic Attack against an Enemy in their Location. If that Attack deals damage, you may move the target Enemy to a connected Location.
cards.flavor: Now! While their guard is broken!

cards.name: Hold Fast
cards.rules: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location and each connected Location. Until the start of your next turn: Each chosen Hero gains Inspired. Each chosen Hero increases their armor by 1. The first time each chosen Hero would be moved to another Location by an enemy effect, ignore that movement.
cards.flavor: Stand your ground. Together, we are unbreakable.

cards.name: Tactical Advance
cards.rules: Move to a connected Location. Then choose one: Increase your armor by 1 until the start of your next turn. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Victory belongs to those who are in the right place at the right time.

cards.name: Shield Escort
cards.rules: Choose one allied Hero in your Location. Move together to a connected Location. Until the start of your next turn, that Hero increases their armor by 1 while they remain in your Location.
cards.flavor: Stay close. I'll see you through.

cards.name: Battlefield Assessment
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. 2) Reveal one unrevealed Location connected to your Location.
cards.flavor: Victory favors those who understand the battlefield before the battle begins.

cards.name: Veteran's Resolve
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Recover 1 discarded Hero Deck card and add it to your hand. 2) Remove one Condition affecting you.
cards.flavor: Experience is measured not by the battles won, but by the resolve to stand again.

cards.name: Last Bastion
cards.rules: Until the start of your next turn: You increase your armor by 2. Other Heroes in your Location gain Inspired. Whenever another Hero in your Location would suffer damage from an Enemy Attack, you may suffer that damage instead. If you prevent damage this way, draw 1 card. (Limit once per Attack.)
cards.flavor: If this is where we make our stand... then none shall pass.

cards.name: Heroic Charge
cards.target: Yourself and up to 2 Allied Heroes
cards.rules: Choose yourself and up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location. Move all chosen Heroes to the same connected Location. Then: Each chosen Hero gains Inspired until the start of your next turn. You may immediately make a basic Attack against an Enemy in that Location. One other chosen Hero may immediately make a basic Attack against an Enemy in that Location.
cards.flavor: With me! Today we reclaim this ground!

cards.name: Quick Strike
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If the Attack defeats the target, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: One clean strike is worth a hundred wild swings.

cards.name: Backstab
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If you have Stealth, this Attack gains +2 Attack. After this Attack resolves, lose Stealth.
cards.flavor: The deadliest blade is the one never seen.

cards.name: Expose Weakness
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If the Attack deals damage, the target gains Exposed until the end of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Armor always has a seam. You simply have to find it.

cards.name: Twin Blades
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Make 2 basic Attacks against the same Enemy. The second Attack suffers -1 Attack. 2) Make 1 basic Attack against each of up to 2 different Enemies in your Location.
cards.flavor: One blade distracts. The other finishes.

cards.name: Shadow Ambush
cards.rules: You may only play this card while you have Stealth. Make a basic Attack with +3 Attack. If this Attack defeats the target: Draw 1 card. You may immediately move to a connected Location. After this Attack resolves, lose Stealth.
cards.flavor: The perfect ambush leaves only silence behind.

cards.name: Throwing Knife
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack against an Enemy in a connected Location. If the target has Exposed, this Attack gains +1.
cards.flavor: Distance is only another angle of attack.

cards.name: Evasive Maneuver
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy declares an Attack against you. Choose one: 1) Gain +2 armor against this Attack. 2) Move to a connected Location. If moving causes the attacking Enemy to no longer be able to target you, the Attack immediately ends.
cards.flavor: You can't hit what isn't there.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.rules: Play when you are targeted by an Enemy Attack. Gain Stealth. The attacking Enemy suffers -2 Attack for this Attack. You may move to a connected Location.
cards.flavor: By the time the smoke clears, she's already gone.

cards.name: Feint
cards.rules: Play after an Enemy Attack against you deals 0 damage. Choose one: 1) Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. 2) The attacking Enemy gains Exposed.
cards.flavor: Sometimes the greatest victory is convincing your opponent they've already won.

cards.name: Uncanny Reflexes
cards.rules: Play when you are targeted by an Enemy Attack. Choose one: 1) Gain Stealth. 2) After that Attack resolves, immediately make a basic Attack against the attacking Enemy if it is a valid target.
cards.flavor: Their mistake becomes your opportunity.

cards.name: Acrobatic Escape
cards.rules: Play after you suffer damage from an Enemy Attack. Reduce that damage by 1. Then choose one: 1) Move to a connected Location. 2) Gain Stealth.
cards.flavor: Every fall is another chance to disappear.

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Reveal one unrevealed Location connected to your Location. 2) Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. If you have Stealth, you may do both instead.
cards.flavor: Knowing where the enemy waits is half the battle.

cards.name: Create Opening
cards.rules: Choose an Enemy in your Location. That Enemy gains Exposed. If you have Stealth, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: They never notice the mistake until it's too late.

cards.name: Shadow Signal
cards.rules: If you have Stealth, reveal yourself. Until the start of your next turn: Allied Heroes gain +1 attack when attacking an Exposed Enemy. The first allied Hero that defeats an Exposed Enemy this round draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: One signal from the shadows, and everyone knows exactly where to strike.

cards.name: Shadowstep
cards.rules: Move to a connected Location. Then choose one: 1) Gain Stealth. 2) Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A single step into darkness can change the entire battle.

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack against an Enemy in your Location. After the Attack resolves, you may move to a connected Location. If the Attack defeated the target, gain Stealth.
cards.flavor: Strike. Vanish. Leave only questions behind.

cards.name: Wall Runner
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected Locations. You may ignore Difficult Terrain and other terrain-based movement restrictions while moving this way. If you end this movement in a Location with no Enemies, gain Stealth.
cards.flavor: Where others see walls, Lyra sees another path.

cards.name: Thieves' Tools
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Disarm a Trap in your Location. 2) Unlock a Locked object in your Location. 3) Gain 2 Insight toward an Objective in your Location.
cards.flavor: Every lock has a key. Sometimes it's just a matter of making one.

cards.name: Case the Area
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Reveal up to 2 connected Locations. 2) Look at the top 3 cards of the Encounter Deck. Return them in any order. If you have Stealth, you may choose both instead.
cards.flavor: Every escape route. Every guard. Every weakness. Know them before the first step.

cards.name: Death from the Shadows
cards.rules: You may only play this card while you have Stealth. Make a basic Attack with +4 Attack. If the target is Exposed, this Attack also gains +1 attack. If the Attack defeats the target: Draw 1 card. Gain Stealth. You may move to a connected Location. After this Attack resolves, lose Stealth unless you regained it from this card.
cards.flavor: They never knew I was there. They never knew I was gone.

cards.name: Vanish Without a Trace
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy Attack is declared against you or when an Enemy enters your Location. Immediately: Gain Stealth. Move to a connected Location. End the triggering Enemy's Attack or movement against you. Until the start of your next turn, you cannot be chosen as the target of Enemy Attacks.
cards.flavor: When they finally realize she's gone... it's already too late.

cards.name: Radiant Strike
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If the target is Undead or Cursed, this Attack gains +1 Attack.

cards.name: Sacred Flame
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack against an Enemy in a connected Location.If this Attack deals damage, choose one Hero in your Location or the target's Location. That Hero recovers 1 Health.

cards.name: Purifying Smite
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, choose one: 1) Remove one Condition from an allied Hero in your Location. 2) If the target is Undead or Cursed, this Attack gains +1 Attack.

cards.name: Consecrated Blow
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn. Consecrated: The first time each Hero in this Location would recover Health each round, they recover 1 additional Health.

cards.name: Judgment of the Faithful
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, choose one allied Hero in your Location. That Hero gains Inspired. If the target is Undead or Cursed, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The Light does not simply punish evil—it strengthens those who stand against it.

cards.name: Beacon of Hope
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage: Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn. Up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location recover 1 Health. If the target is Undead or Cursed, each healed Hero may also remove one Condition.
cards.flavor: Where hope shines brightest, darkness cannot endure.

cards.name: Divine Shield
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in your Location is declared the target of an Enemy Attack. That Hero gains +2 armor against this Attack. If the Hero suffers no damage from this Attack, they recover 1 Health.
cards.flavor: Faith is the shield that no blade can pierce.

cards.name: Guardian's Blessing
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2. If all damage is prevented, that Hero gains Inspired.
cards.flavor: The Light reaches even those beyond my sight.

cards.name: Sanctuary
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy ability or Attack would affect two or more allied Heroes in your Location. Until the end of the current Attack or ability: Allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 armor. Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Stand together, and the Light shall shelter you all.

cards.name: Intercession
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location would be defeated. Instead, that Hero remains at 1 Health. Remove all Conditions from that Hero. That Hero cannot recover Health until the end of the current Enemy turn.
cards.flavor: Your journey is not yet over.

cards.name: Aegis of the Dawn
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy Attack or ability would affect one or more allied Heroes in your Location. Until the end of the current Attack or ability: Allied Heroes in your Location cannot have their Health reduced below 1. Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn. After this effect resolves, each protected Hero recovers 1 Health.
cards.flavor: When dawn breaks, despair yields to hope.

cards.name: Bless
cards.rules: Choose up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero gains Inspired. If your Location is Consecrated, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: May your hands be steady, your heart unwavering, and your spirit filled with ...

cards.name: Prayer of Restoration
cards.rules: Choose up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero chooses one: 1) Recovers 1 Health 2) Removes one Condition. If your Location is Consecrated, one chosen Hero may both recover 1 Health and remove one Condition.
cards.flavor: Healing begins with faith, but true restoration renews both body and spirit.

cards.name: Divine Communion
cards.rules: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero chooses one: 1) Recover 2 Health. 2) Remove one Condition. 3) Gain Inspired. If your Location is Consecrated, each chosen Hero may choose two different options instead.
cards.flavor: Together, we are stronger than darkness. Together, we endure.

cards.name: Guided Path
cards.rules: Move to a connected Location. Choose one: 1) Recover 1 Health. 2)Remove one Condition from yourself. If you move into a Consecrated Location, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The Light always reveals the way forward.

cards.name: Shepherd the Faithful
cards.rules: Choose one allied Hero in your Location. 1) You and the chosen Hero each move to the same connected Location. 2) After moving, one of you recovers 1 Health.
cards.flavor: No soul walks alone beneath the Light.

cards.name: Wings of Mercy
cards.rules: Move to any connected Location, ignoring enemy movement restrictions. After moving, choose one: 1) One allied Hero in your Location recovers 2 Health. 2) Remove one Condition from each allied Hero in your Location. Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Where suffering calls, the Light arrives.

cards.name: Holy Insight
cards.rules: Choose one: 1) Reveal all face-down tokens in your Location. 2) Gain 2 Insight toward the current Objective. If your Location is Consecrated, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The Light reveals what darkness seeks to hide.

cards.name: Rite of Purification
cards.rules:
Choose one: 1) Remove one negative Location Effect from your Location. 2) Remove one Trap or Hazard in your Location. 3) Gain 2 Insight toward the current Objective.
If your Location is Consecrated, you may choose two different options instead.
cards.flavor: No corruption can endure where the Light is welcomed.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.rules: Play when an allied Hero would be defeated. Instead: That Hero remains at 1 Health. Remove all Conditions from that Hero. Move Sister Elara to that Hero's Location.
cards.flavor: The Light has not finished with you.

cards.name: Light of Ascendance
cards.rules: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero: Recovers 2 Health. Removes one Condition. Gains Inspired.
cards.flavor: Stand together in the Light, and no darkness shall overcome you.

cards.name: Arcane Bolt
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack against an enemy in your Location or a connected Location. If you are in an Arcane Location, this Attack gains +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: Even the simplest spell becomes extraordinary in the hands of a master.

cards.name: Arcane Missile
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. This Attack gains +1 attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, after this Attack resolves, you may choose another enemy in your Location or a connected Location. Deal 1 damage to the chosen enemy.
cards.flavor: One spell is a threat. A master makes it many.

cards.name: Frost Nova
cards.rules: Choose up to 3 enemies in your Location. Each chosen enemy suffers a basic Attack. After resolving these Attacks, choose one enemy damaged by this card. Move that enemy to a connected Location of your choice. If you are in an Arcane Location, you may instead move up to two damaged enemies.
cards.flavor: The bitter cold stills both blade and courage.

cards.name: Arcane Surge
cards.rules: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, choose one: 1) Deal 1 damage to another enemy in the target's Location. 2) Push the target to a connected Location. If you are in an Arcane Location, you may choose both options instead.
cards.flavor: Power is not measured by destruction, but by control.

cards.name: Gravity Well
cards.rules: Choose a Location within range. Move up to 2 enemies from connected Locations into the chosen Location. Then make a basic Attack against each enemy moved this way. If the chosen Location is an Arcane Location, those Attacks gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: The stars themselves answer my command.

cards.name: Meteor Shard
cards.rules: Choose a Location within range and up to 3 enemies there. Each chosen enemy suffers a basic Attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, each enemy damaged by this card gains Burning. Burning: At the start of that enemy's next activation, it suffers 1 damage, then remove Burning.
cards.flavor: A fragment of the heavens is more than enough.

cards.name: Arcane Barrier
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in your Location is declared the target of an Enemy Attack. That Hero gains +2 armor against this Attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, the attacking enemy suffers 1 damage after the Attack resolves.
cards.flavor: Every spell cast against me strengthens my resolve.

cards.name: Blink
cards.rules: Play when you are declared the target of an Enemy Attack. Move to a connected Location. If the Attack is no longer valid, it immediately ends. If you move into an Arcane Location, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A wise wizard knows that the best defense is simply not being there.

cards.name: Spell Reflection
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location is targeted by an Enemy ability or Spell. Cancel that ability or Spell unless its source pays 1 additional Action. If it cannot, the ability or Spell is canceled. If the canceled ability or Spell targeted only one Hero and you are in an Arcane Location, deal 2 damage to its source.
cards.flavor: Magic is a conversation. I simply choose the final word.

cards.name: Phase Shift
cards.rules: Play when you would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2. You may then move to a connected Location. If you move into an Arcane Location, recover 1 Health.
cards.flavor: The body is merely another state of matter.

cards.name: Temporal Stasis
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location would be defeated. That Hero cannot be reduced below 1 Health by the triggering Attack or ability. Remove that Hero from the battlefield. Return that Hero to their previous Location at the start of your next turn with 1 Health. If you are in an Arcane Location, that Hero also draws 1 card when they return.
cards.flavor: For but a heartbeat, time itself stands still.

cards.name: Arcane Intellect
cards.rules: Choose yourself or one allied Hero in your Location. That Hero draws 2 cards, then discards 1 card. If you are in an Arcane Location, the chosen Hero does not discard a card.
cards.flavor: Knowledge gained at the right moment is more valuable than any blade.

cards.name: Arcane Infusion
cards.rules: Choose one allied Hero in your Location. Until the end of that Hero's next turn, the first Attack card they play gains +1 Attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, that Hero also gains Inspired.
cards.flavor: Magic does not replace skill—it elevates it.

cards.name: Leyline Convergence
cards.rules: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location. Until the start of your next turn, the first Hero card each chosen Hero plays costs 1 fewer Action (minimum 1). Your Location becomes an Arcane Location until the start of your next turn. If your Location is already an Arcane Location, each chosen Hero draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: When every thread of magic is woven together, the impossible becomes inevitable.

cards.name: Teleport
cards.rules: Move to any connected Location, ignoring enemy movement restrictions. If you move into an Arcane Location, draw 1 card. Otherwise, you may create an Arcane Location in your new Location until the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Distance is merely a limitation of ordinary minds.

cards.name: Dimension Door
cards.rules: Choose yourself and one allied Hero in your Location. Move both Heroes to the same connected Location. This movement ignores enemy movement restrictions. If the destination is an Arcane Location, each moved Hero recovers 1 Health. Otherwise, the destination becomes an Arcane Location until the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: The shortest path is the one that ignores reality.

cards.name: Ethereal Passage
cards.rules: Move to any Location within 2 connections, ignoring all enemy movement restrictions and hazards. You do not trigger enemy abilities or effects caused by movement during this move. If you end this movement in an Arcane Location, recover 1 Health and draw 1 card. Otherwise, create an Arcane Location in your destination until the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: For a fleeting moment, the world becomes little more than mist.

cards.name: Detect Magic
cards.rules: Look at the top three cards of the Equipment Deck and return them in any order. If you are at an arcane location return one to the bottom of the equipment deck.
cards.flavor: The currents of fate leave traces for those who know where to look.

cards.name: Arcane Ward
cards.rules: Choose one Location. Place an Arcane Ward token in that Location. While an Arcane Ward is present: That Location is treated as an Arcane Location. The first enemy that enters that Location each round suffers 2 damage. Remove the Arcane Ward after it triggers 3 times. Only one Arcane Ward may exist at a time. If you create a new Arcane Ward, remove the previous one.
cards.flavor: Every step toward me is a step through my magic.

cards.name: Time Stop
cards.rules: Until the start of your next turn:	Enemies cannot Move or play Reaction abilities. The first Attack played by each allied Hero this round gains +1 Attack. You may immediately play 1 additional Hero card without spending an Action. If you begin this spell while in an Arcane Location, draw 2 cards after resolving this card. Limit 1 per campaign.
cards.flavor: For one impossible moment, the world obeys only my will.

cards.name: Arcane Cataclysm
cards.rules: Choose up to 3 Locations. Each enemy in the chosen Locations suffers an Attack with +3 Attack. After resolving all Attacks: Push each damaged enemy to a connected Location of your choice. Each chosen Location becomes an Arcane Location until the end of the encounter. If a chosen Location was already an Arcane Location, each allied Hero there recovers 2 Health and draws 1 card. Limit 1 per campaign.
cards.flavor: The battlefield itself becomes my spell.

cards.name: Hunter's Shot
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If the target is Marked, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Every hunt begins with patience.

cards.name: Quick Shot
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections with -1 Attack. You may play this card before or after a Move during your turn.
cards.flavor: Speed wins where strength cannot.

cards.name: Pinning Arrow
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If the attack deals damage, the target gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: Stand still.

cards.name: Longbow Volley
cards.rules: Make one Attack against each Enemy in your Location. Resolve each Attack separately.
cards.flavor: A storm of arrows darkened the sky.

cards.name: Armor Piercer
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. Ignore 2 Armor when resolving this Attack.
cards.flavor: Even steel has weak points.

cards.name: Ricochet Arrow
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If it deals damage, immediately make a basic Attack against a second Enemy within 1 connection of the first target.
cards.flavor: One arrow. Two chances.

cards.name: Predator's Mark
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy within 3 connections. It becomes Marked until the end of the round. Attacks against it gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: Nothing escapes my sight.

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.rules: Choose one revealed Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in that Location.
cards.flavor: The forest itself turned against them.

cards.name: Set Snare
cards.rules: Place a Snare token in a connected revealed Location. The first Enemy entering that Location suffers 2 damage and gains Rooted; then remove the token.
cards.flavor: A careless step ends the hunt.

cards.name: Camouflage
cards.rules: Gain Hidden until the start of your next turn. Hidden ends early if you Attack.
cards.flavor: The woods hide those who respect them.

cards.name: Beast Lore
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy in your Location. Until the end of the round, allied Heroes gain +1 Attack against it.
cards.flavor: Every creature leaves a weakness behind.

cards.name: Eagle Eye
cards.rules: Look at the top 3 cards of the Exploration Deck and return them in any order.
cards.flavor: The horizon tells stories to those who look.

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.rules: Reveal one connected unrevealed Location without spending an Explore Action. Resolve its Reveal Effect normally.
cards.flavor: I'll make sure the path is clear.

cards.name: Trailblazer
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in your Location. That Hero may immediately Move to a connected revealed Location without spending an Action, if not Engaged.
cards.flavor: Stay close.

cards.name: Swift Advance
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. The first time this movement would leave Difficult Terrain, ignore its additional Move requirement.
cards.flavor: Never stay where the enemy expects.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring one movement restriction caused by terrain or an Enemy effect. If you end with no Enemy in your Location, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Height is an advantage.

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy enters a Location within 3 connections that Rowan can target. Immediately make a basic Attack against that Enemy before it completes its activation.
cards.flavor: Not one step further.

cards.name: Dodge Roll
cards.rules: Play when Rowan is targeted by an Attack. Gain Guarded until that Attack is resolved.
cards.flavor: Too slow.

cards.name: Master's Hunt
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against a Marked Enemy within 3 connections. Ignore all Armor. If it is Defeated, you may immediately play one Attack card without paying its Action Cost.
cards.flavor: The hunt ends now.

cards.name: Arrow Storm
cards.rules: Choose one revealed Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +2 Attack against every Enemy there. After resolving, each surviving Enemy becomes Marked until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: The sky vanished beneath a rain of arrows.

cards.name: Blessed Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If this Attack Defeats the target, one other Hero in your Location recovers 1 Health.
cards.flavor: Mercy follows justice.

cards.name: Shield Bash
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If it deals damage, the target gains Stunned until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: Stand down.

cards.name: Smite Evil
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack if the target damaged a Hero this round.
cards.flavor: Your crimes are remembered.

cards.name: Cleansing Blow
cards.rules: Remove one harmful Status from yourself or another Hero in your Location, then make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location.
cards.flavor: Light burns corruption away.

cards.name: Divine Smite
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. Against an Undead, Demon, or Corrupted Enemy, ignore all Armor.
cards.flavor: No darkness endures forever.

cards.name: Hammer of Judgment
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If it deals damage, move the target to a connected Location if legal.
cards.flavor: Judgment has weight.

cards.name: Holy Retribution
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack. If Seraphine was attacked since her previous turn, draw 1 card after resolving.
cards.flavor: Strike me, and face the consequence.

cards.name: Radiant Judgment
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy in your Location.
cards.flavor: The light shines on all.

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in your Location. That Hero recovers 2 Health.
cards.flavor: Rise.

cards.name: Holy Challenge
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy in your Location. It gains Taunted by Seraphine until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: Face me instead.

cards.name: Oathkeeper's Resolve
cards.rules: Seraphine gains Guarded. Then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Faith cannot be broken.

cards.name: Aura of Courage
cards.rules: All Heroes in Seraphine's Location gain Inspired until the start of her next turn.
cards.flavor: Stand together.

cards.name: Sanctuary
cards.rules: Until the start of Seraphine's next turn, Heroes in her Location reduce damage from Enemy Attacks by 1, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Within these walls, hope endures.

cards.name: Divine Blessing
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in your Location. Their next Attack this turn gains +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: May your hand be guided.

cards.name: Faithful Advance
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. One allied Hero in your Location may move with you if both Heroes are not prevented from moving.
cards.flavor: No one walks alone.

cards.name: Guardian's Charge
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, then immediately make a basic Attack against one Enemy there.
cards.flavor: The shield arrives before the fear.

cards.name: Divine Intercession
cards.rules: Play when another Hero in Seraphine's Location would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Their burden is mine.

cards.name: Stand Firm
cards.rules: Play when Seraphine would be Pushed, Rooted, or Knocked Down. Ignore that effect.
cards.flavor: I will not yield.

cards.name: Avenging Light
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. If the target damaged an allied Hero this round, ignore all Armor and Seraphine recovers 1 Health.
cards.flavor: Justice arrives with the dawn.

cards.name: Beacon of Hope
cards.rules: Each Hero in Seraphine's Location recovers 2 Health, removes one harmful Status, and gains Inspired until the start of Seraphine's next turn.
cards.flavor: Where hope stands, darkness falters.

cards.name: Thorn Whip
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections. If it deals damage and the target is in a connected Location, move it into Thorne's Location.
cards.flavor: The forest reaches for its prey.

cards.name: Vine Lash
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections. If it deals damage, the target gains Rooted.
cards.flavor: Roots remember every trespass.

cards.name: Stone Bark
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy in your Location. After resolving, Thorne gains Guarded.
cards.flavor: Oak and stone share the same resolve.

cards.name: Nature's Wrath
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in Thorne's Location.
cards.flavor: The wild has awakened.

cards.name: Crushing Roots
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If the target is Rooted, gain an additional +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Once trapped, there is no escape.

cards.name: Spirit Wolf
cards.rules: Place a Spirit Wolf token in Thorne's Location, replacing his existing Spirit Wolf if necessary. It immediately deals 2 damage to one Enemy there. The Spirit Wolf follows the Spirit Wolf rules and remains until Defeated or the encounter ends.
cards.flavor: Ancient guardians answer the call.

cards.name: Briar Storm
cards.rules: Make an Attack against each Enemy in Thorne's Location. Each Enemy damaged gains Bleeding.
cards.flavor: Even the smallest thorn can draw blood.

cards.name: Wrath of the Forest
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in Thorne's Location. Rooted Enemies suffer +1 damage after Armor.
cards.flavor: The forest itself delivers judgment.

cards.name: Entangling Vines
cards.rules: Place a Vine Terrain token in a connected revealed Location. The first time each Enemy enters that Location, it gains Slowed until the end of its activation.
cards.flavor: Nature reshapes the battlefield.

cards.name: Wild Growth
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Thorne's Location. That Hero gains Regenerating until the end of their next turn.
cards.flavor: Life finds a way.

cards.name: Animal Speech
cards.rules: Look at the top 2 cards of the Exploration Deck. You may discard one; return the other to the top.
cards.flavor: The birds know every trail.

cards.name: Nature's Blessing
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Thorne's Location. That Hero recovers 1 Health and removes Bleeding or Burning.
cards.flavor: The woods mend all wounds.

cards.name: Forest Shelter
cards.rules: Until the start of Thorne's next turn, Heroes in his Location reduce incoming damage by 1, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Even in darkness, the trees protect.

cards.name: Ancient Wisdom
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Thorne's Location. That Hero draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Listen to the oldest voices.

cards.name: Woodland Stride
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. The first time this movement would leave Difficult Terrain, ignore its additional Move requirement.
cards.flavor: Every path belongs to the forest.

cards.name: Vine Walk
cards.rules: Move Thorne to any revealed Location containing a Vine Terrain token. This movement ignores Engagement.
cards.flavor: The roots connect all things.

cards.name: Barkskin
cards.rules: Play when Thorne is targeted by an Attack. Gain +2 Armor for that Attack.
cards.flavor: Wood is stronger than steel.

cards.name: Protective Roots
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in Thorne's Location would be moved by an Enemy effect. Ignore that movement.
cards.flavor: The earth refuses to let go.

cards.name: Heart of the Forest
cards.rules: Until the start of Thorne's next turn, Heroes in his Location gain Regenerating and +1 Armor.
cards.flavor: Stand where the ancient trees still breathe.

cards.name: Avatar of Nature
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in Thorne's Location. Until the start of his next turn, Thorne gains +2 Armor and ignores Rooted and Slowed.
cards.flavor: For one fleeting moment, the wild walks as a man.

cards.name: Piercing Note
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections. If it deals damage, the target gains Shaken until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: One perfect note can shatter resolve.

cards.name: Rapier Flourish
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. After resolving, Cassian may Move to a connected revealed Location if not Engaged.
cards.flavor: Every duel deserves an audience.

cards.name: Discordant Chord
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections. If it deals damage, the target gains Weakened until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: Even monsters dislike bad music.

cards.name: Crescendo
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in Cassian's Location.
cards.flavor: The performance reaches its peak.

cards.name: Cutting Words
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack. If the target has any harmful Status, draw 1 card after resolving.
cards.flavor: Sometimes words cut deeper than blades.

cards.name: Echoing Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If it Defeats the target, immediately make a basic Attack against another Enemy within 2 connections.
cards.flavor: Every note deserves an encore.

cards.name: Ballad of Heroes
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. After resolving, choose one other Hero in Cassian's Location; they gain Inspired until the end of their next turn.
cards.flavor: Victory is always worth singing about.

cards.name: Final Verse
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in Cassian's Location. Enemies with any harmful Status suffer +1 damage after Armor.
cards.flavor: Every story deserves a memorable ending.

cards.name: Inspiring Ballad
cards.rules: All Heroes in Cassian's Location gain Inspired until the start of Cassian's next turn.
cards.flavor: Sing louder!

cards.name: Distracting Tune
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy in Cassian's Location. It gains Weakened until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: Keep your eyes on me.

cards.name: Encore
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Cassian's Location. Return one Support card from that Hero's discard pile to their hand.
cards.flavor: One more time.

cards.name: Song of Rest
cards.rules: Each Hero in Cassian's Location recovers 1 Health.
cards.flavor: Even heroes need a quiet moment.

cards.name: Rallying Chorus
cards.rules: Each Hero in Cassian's Location draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: Raise your voices together.

cards.name: Quick Tempo
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Cassian's Location. The next Hero Deck card they play this turn costs 1 fewer Action, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Keep up!

cards.name: Stage Presence
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. Before moving, allied Heroes in Cassian's current Location gain Inspired until the end of their next turn.
cards.flavor: A true performer owns every room.

cards.name: Dancing Footwork
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. Ignore Engagement during this movement.
cards.flavor: Grace is its own defense.

cards.name: Counter Melody
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy in Cassian's Location triggers a non-Attack ability. Cancel one non-Attack effect from that ability.
cards.flavor: Every song has a harmony.

cards.name: Standing Ovation
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in Cassian's Location Defeats an Enemy. That Hero draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: The crowd erupts in applause.

cards.name: Symphony of Valor
cards.rules: Each Hero in Cassian's Location gains Inspired, gains +1 Attack until the start of Cassian's next turn, and recovers 1 Health.
cards.flavor: One song can inspire legends.

cards.name: Grand Finale
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy in Cassian's Location. Then each Hero there draws 1 card and gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.
cards.flavor: The last note echoes long after the battle ends.

cards.name: Flying Kick
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy in Kael's Location. If Kael played another card earlier this turn, gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: Momentum is the first weapon.

cards.name: Palm Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Stunned until the end of its next activation.
cards.flavor: The smallest motion changes the battle.

cards.name: Sweeping Leg
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Knocked Down.
cards.flavor: Even giants fall.

cards.name: Twin Strike
cards.rules: Make two basic Attacks against the same Enemy. Resolve them separately.
cards.flavor: One strike becomes two.

cards.name: Flowing Strikes
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack for each Attack card Kael played earlier this turn, maximum +3.
cards.flavor: Every blow feeds the next.

cards.name: Dragon Fist
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. Ignore 2 Armor.
cards.flavor: Strength without discipline is wasted.

cards.name: Cyclone Kick
cards.rules: Make an Attack against each Enemy in Kael's Location.
cards.flavor: Become the storm.

cards.name: Hundred Blows
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If this is the third Attack card Kael played this turn, ignore all Armor.
cards.flavor: No opening goes unpunished.

cards.name: Centered Mind
cards.rules: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Calm before action.

cards.name: Crane Stance
cards.rules: Kael gains Guarded. His next Attack this turn may target an Enemy in a connected Location.
cards.flavor: Balance is power.

cards.name: Tiger Stance
cards.rules: Kael's next Attack this turn gains +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Strike with certainty.

cards.name: Meditate
cards.rules: Kael recovers 2 Health and removes one harmful Status.
cards.flavor: Peace sharpens the spirit.

cards.name: Inner Focus
cards.rules: The next Hero Deck card Kael plays this turn costs 1 fewer Action, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Master yourself first.

cards.name: Perfect Rhythm
cards.rules: If Kael has played at least two cards earlier this turn, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Every movement has purpose.

cards.name: Wind Step
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. Ignore Engagement during this movement.
cards.flavor: Leave only footprints.

cards.name: Wall Run
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring one terrain restriction. Kael's next Attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: No obstacle is permanent.

cards.name: Deflect
cards.rules: Play when Kael is targeted by a Ranged Attack. Reduce the damage from that Attack by 2, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: A calm hand changes everything.

cards.name: Counter Strike
cards.rules: Play after an Enemy's Attack against Kael deals 0 damage. Kael immediately makes a basic Attack against that Enemy if it is in his Location.
cards.flavor: Every mistake has a price.

cards.name: Whirlwind Master
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in Kael's Location. Gain +1 additional Attack for each Attack card played earlier this turn, maximum +3 additional.
cards.flavor: Motion becomes legend.

cards.name: Perfect Form
cards.rules: Until end of turn, Kael's Attack cards cost 1 fewer Action, minimum 1, and gain +1 Attack. After each Attack card resolves, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Body, mind, and spirit move as one.

cards.name: Precision Bolt
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If the target has any Status, gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: Every machine has a weak point.

cards.name: Repeating Shot
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. After resolving, you may discard 1 card to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Reload? Already done.

cards.name: Shock Cartridge
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections. If it deals damage, the target gains Shocked until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: A little extra voltage.

cards.name: Scatter Shot
cards.rules: Make an Attack against each Enemy in Mira's Location.
cards.flavor: Stand back!

cards.name: Explosive Charge
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections. If it deals damage, the target gains Burning.
cards.flavor: Loud problems require louder solutions.

cards.name: Armor Breaker
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. Ignore 2 Armor.
cards.flavor: Everything can be dismantled.

cards.name: Arc Cannon
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. Then deal 2 damage to a second Enemy in the target's Location.
cards.flavor: Conductive enough.

cards.name: Overloaded Reactor
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in Mira's Location. Enemies already Burning suffer +1 damage after Armor.
cards.flavor: Engineering is controlled chaos.

cards.name: Deploy Turret
cards.rules: Place a Turret token in Mira's Location. Once during each of Mira's turns, the Turret may deal 2 damage to one Enemy in that Location. The Turret follows the Turret rules. Only one Turret may be in play.
cards.flavor: Watch my flank.

cards.name: Mechanical Trap
cards.rules: Place a Trap token in a connected revealed Location. The first Enemy entering suffers 2 damage and gains Rooted; then remove the token.
cards.flavor: Predictable enemies are easy enemies.

cards.name: Emergency Repair
cards.rules: Choose one Hero or Construct in Mira's Location. A Hero recovers 2 Health, or a Construct restores 2 Health.
cards.flavor: Hold still.

cards.name: Field Workshop
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Mira's Location. The next Equipment-related card or interaction they use this turn costs 1 fewer Action, minimum 0. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Tools solve everything.

cards.name: Tactical Upgrade
cards.rules: Choose one Hero in Mira's Location. Their next Attack this turn gains +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: A small adjustment makes a big difference.

cards.name: Efficient Design
cards.rules: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Every blueprint improves.

cards.name: Grapple Launcher
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. Ignore Engagement during this movement.
cards.flavor: Vertical solutions are still solutions.

cards.name: Rocket Boots
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. Mira's next Attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: Mostly safe.

cards.name: Energy Shield
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in Mira's Location would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Prototype successful.

cards.name: Automatic Countermeasure
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy enters Mira's Location. Deal 2 damage to that Enemy before it continues its activation.
cards.flavor: Security system activated.

cards.name: Master Engineer
cards.rules: Until the start of Mira's next turn, Turrets and Constructs gain +2 damage and +2 maximum/current Health. Each Hero in Mira's Location may immediately use one Consumable without spending an Action.
cards.flavor: Preparation wins wars.

cards.name: Grand Invention
cards.rules: If no Turret is in play, place one in Mira's Location. Then make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy there. Each surviving Enemy gains Burning.
cards.flavor: Innovation changes everything.

cards.name: Fire Bolt
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. This Attack gains +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: A spark is enough when you know exactly where to place it.

cards.name: Lightning Lance
cards.rules: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. This Attack gains +4 Attack.
cards.flavor: The shortest path between two points is lightning.

cards.name: Scorching Ray
cards.rules: Make two Attacks, each with +1 Attack, against Enemies within 3 connections. The Attacks may target different Enemies.
cards.flavor: One flame distracts. The second kills.

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. Then make an Attack with +1 Attack against a different Enemy in that Enemy's Location.
cards.flavor: Power seeks another path.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.rules: Choose a revealed Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy there.
cards.flavor: Subtlety is for people with smaller fireballs.

cards.name: Inferno
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy in your Location and each connected Location.
cards.flavor: There is nowhere nearby that is far enough away.

cards.name: Arc Lightning
cards.rules: Choose one Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against up to 3 different Enemies there.
cards.flavor: Three targets. One current.

cards.name: Flame Wave
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy in your Location.
cards.flavor: The safest place is behind the wizard.

cards.name: Combustion
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If this Attack defeats it, deal 2 damage to another Enemy in its Location.
cards.flavor: Everything burns eventually.

cards.name: Focused Destruction
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +5 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections.
cards.flavor: All that power, pointed at one unfortunate problem.

cards.name: Elemental Surge
cards.rules: Malachar's next Attack this turn gains +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Power first. Questions later.

cards.name: Mana Burn
cards.rules: Malachar suffers 1 damage. Gain 1 Action. This cannot raise him above 3 Actions, and the gained Action may only be spent to play an Attack card this turn.
cards.flavor: Pain is simply another kind of fuel.

cards.name: Blink
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring Engagement during this movement.
cards.flavor: The explosion is much prettier from over here.

cards.name: Arcane Barrier
cards.rules: Play when Malachar would suffer damage from an Enemy Attack or ability. Reduce that damage by 3, minimum 0.
cards.flavor: Even destruction needs a shield sometimes.

cards.name: Volatile Magic
cards.rules: Malachar's next Attack this turn gains +3 Attack. After that Attack resolves, Malachar suffers 1 damage.
cards.flavor: Restraint is just wasted potential.

cards.name: Conduit
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy within 3 connections. Malachar's next Attack against that Enemy this turn gains +3 Attack.
cards.flavor: Once the path is open, the storm follows.

cards.name: Meteor
cards.rules: Choose a revealed Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +5 Attack against each Enemy there. After resolving all Attacks, Malachar suffers 2 damage.
cards.flavor: Look up.

cards.name: Static Reprisal
cards.rules: Play after an Enemy within 3 connections damages Malachar. Deal 2 Lightning damage to that Enemy.
cards.flavor: Touch the storm and it touches back.

cards.name: Overcharged Casting
cards.rules: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. You may suffer 1 damage to draw 1 additional card.
cards.flavor: More power always has a price.

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.traits: Arcane; Fire; Lightning; Legendary Spell; Evocation
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy within 2 connections. You may Overload this card even if you have already used Arcane Overload this Round. Limit 1 per Quest.
cards.flavor: When Malachar stops holding back, the battlefield notices.

cards.name: Savage Chop
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy in your Location.

cards.name: Reckless Swing
cards.rules: Suffer 1 damage. Make an Attack with +4 Attack against one Enemy in your Location.

cards.name: Crushing Blow
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. This Attack ignores 1 Armor.

cards.name: Sweeping Cleave
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against up to two different Enemies in your Location.

cards.name: Bloodied Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If Garruk is at half his Maximum Health or less, this Attack gains +3 Attack.

cards.name: Executioner's Swing
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. If the target is at half its Maximum Health or less, gain an additional +2 Attack.

cards.name: Rampage
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, then make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy there. If it is defeated, make a basic Attack against another Enemy there.

cards.name: Groundbreaker
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in your Location.

cards.name: Headlong Charge
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location containing an Enemy. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy there.

cards.name: No Mercy
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +4 Attack against one Enemy that has a harmful Status Effect.

cards.name: Battle Roar
cards.rules: Until the end of Garruk's turn, his Attacks gain +1 Attack.

cards.name: Feed the Rage
cards.rules: Suffer 1 damage. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Ignore the Pain
cards.rules: Play when Garruk would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0.

cards.name: Too Angry to Fall
cards.rules: Play when Garruk would be reduced to 0 Health. He remains at 1 Health instead. Limit 1 per Quest.

cards.name: Warpath
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. If an Enemy is there, Garruk's next Attack this turn gains +1 Attack.

cards.name: Break Free
cards.rules: Remove Stunned, Rooted, or Weakened from Garruk.

cards.name: Challenge the Strongest
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy in Garruk's Location. It gains Marked by Garruk until the end of its next activation. Garruk's next Attack against it gains +2 Attack.

cards.name: Blood for Blood
cards.rules: Play after an Enemy in Garruk's Location damages him. Make a basic Attack against that Enemy.

cards.name: Berserker Frenzy
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy in Garruk's Location. Garruk suffers 1 damage after all Attacks resolve.

cards.name: Avatar of Rage
cards.rules: Until the end of Garruk's next turn, his Attacks gain +3 Attack and he cannot be reduced below 1 Health. Limit 1 per Quest.

cards.name: Shadow Bolt
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.

cards.name: Hexing Blast
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Weakened until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Marked for Ruin
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. The target gains Marked until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Agonizing Curse
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. If the target already has a harmful Status Effect, gain +2 additional Attack.

cards.name: Withering Ray
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Weakened.

cards.name: Cursed Chain
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against up to two Enemies in the same Location. Each damaged target gains Marked.

cards.name: Soul Rend
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. If the target has a harmful Status Effect and is defeated, recover 1 Health.

cards.name: Black Flame
cards.rules: Choose a Location within 2 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy there. Afflicted Enemies take +1 Attack.

cards.name: Curse of Frailty
cards.rules: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Weakened until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Doom Mark
cards.rules: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Marked until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Spread the Misery
cards.rules: Choose an afflicted Enemy and another Enemy in the same Location. Copy one harmful Status Effect from the first to the second.

cards.name: Dark Bargain
cards.rules: Suffer 1 damage. Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring Engagement during this movement.

cards.name: Warding Hex
cards.rules: Play when an Enemy within 2 connections declares an Attack. That Enemy gains Weakened for the triggering Attack.

cards.name: Soul Shield
cards.rules: Play when Veyra would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2. If the source has a harmful Status Effect, reduce it by 3 instead.

cards.name: Cruel Insight
cards.rules: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. If an Enemy in Veyra's Location is afflicted, do not discard.

cards.name: Malefic Echo
cards.rules: Play after an afflicted Enemy removes a harmful Status Effect. Reapply that Status Effect until the end of its current activation.

cards.name: Harvest Despair
cards.rules: Choose one afflicted Enemy within 2 connections. Veyra recovers 1 Health and her next Attack against it this turn gains +1 Attack.

cards.name: Plague of Curses
cards.rules: Choose one Location within 2 connections. Each Enemy there gains Weakened and Marked until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Damnation
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each afflicted Enemy within 2 connections. Limit 1 per Quest.

cards.name: Grave Bolt
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.

cards.name: Bone Spear
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. This Attack ignores 1 Armor.

cards.name: Deathly Touch
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy in Mordren's Location.

cards.name: Grave Burst
cards.rules: Choose a Location within 2 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy there.

cards.name: Servant Assault
cards.rules: Choose a Bone Servant in Mordren's Location. It deals 2 damage to one Enemy there.

cards.name: Bone Legion
cards.rules: Each Bone Servant deals 2 damage to one Enemy in its Location.

cards.name: Corpse Explosion
cards.rules: Remove one Bone Servant. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in that Servant's Location.

cards.name: Life Drain
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If it deals damage, Mordren recovers 1 Health.

cards.name: Raise Bone Servant
cards.rules: Place a Bone Servant in Mordren's Location, up to his maximum.

cards.name: Grave March
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. One Bone Servant in Mordren's previous Location may move with him.

cards.name: Sacrificial Power
cards.rules: Remove one Bone Servant. Mordren's next Attack this turn gains +4 Attack.

cards.name: Bone Shield
cards.rules: Play when Mordren would suffer damage. Remove a Bone Servant in his Location to reduce that damage by 4, minimum 0.

cards.name: Dead Interpose
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in a Location containing a Bone Servant would suffer damage. Remove that Servant and reduce the damage by 3, minimum 0.

cards.name: Grave Recall
cards.rules: Move one Bone Servant within 2 connections to Mordren's Location.

cards.name: Harvest Essence
cards.rules: Remove one Bone Servant. Draw 2 cards and recover 1 Health.

cards.name: Death's Patience
cards.rules: Until the end of Mordren's turn, the first time an Enemy is defeated within 2 connections, place a Bone Servant in that Location, up to his maximum.

cards.name: Grasping Dead
cards.rules: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Command the Fallen
cards.rules: Play after an Enemy enters a Location containing a Bone Servant. That Servant deals 2 damage to the Enemy.

cards.name: Army of Bones
cards.rules: Place a Bone Servant in Mordren's Location and each connected revealed Location, up to his maximum.

cards.name: Death Unbound
cards.rules: Each Bone Servant deals 3 damage to one Enemy in its Location. Then Mordren may remove any number of Bone Servants; for each removed this way, draw 1 card or recover 1 Health. Limit 1 per Quest.

cards.name: Quick Thrust
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy in Lucien's Location.

cards.name: Lunging Strike
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, then make a basic Attack against one Enemy there.

cards.name: Duelist's Cut
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If the target is the only Enemy in Lucien's Location, gain +3 Attack.

cards.name: Flashing Blades
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against up to two different Enemies in Lucien's Location.

cards.name: Riposte
cards.rules: Play after an Enemy Attack against Lucien deals 0 damage. Make a basic Attack against that Enemy if it is a valid target.

cards.name: Passing Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack. After it resolves, Lucien may Move to a connected revealed Location if able.

cards.name: Precision Lunge
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +4 Attack against one Enemy in Lucien's Location.

cards.name: Flourish
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Marked by Lucien until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Dashing Assault
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy there. Lucien may then Move back to his previous Location.

cards.name: Finishing Thrust
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If the target is at half its Maximum Health or less, gain +2 additional Attack.

cards.name: Fancy Footwork
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring Engagement during this movement.

cards.name: Vault
cards.rules: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. Lucien cannot end this movement in his starting Location.

cards.name: En Garde
cards.rules: Play when Lucien is targeted by an Enemy Attack. Reduce damage from that Attack by 2, minimum 0.

cards.name: Sidestep
cards.rules: Play when Lucien is targeted by an Enemy Attack. Move to a connected revealed Location. If the Attack is no longer valid, it ends.

cards.name: Taunting Salute
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy in Lucien's Location. It gains Marked by Lucien until the end of its next activation. Lucien's next Attack against it this turn gains +1 Attack.

cards.name: Opening Found
cards.rules: Lucien's next melee Attack this turn gains +2 Attack. If he Moved this turn, draw 1 card after that Attack resolves.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.rules: Lucien recovers 2 Health.

cards.name: Acrobatic Escape
cards.rules: Play after Lucien suffers damage. Move to a connected revealed Location if able.

cards.name: Master Duelist
cards.rules: Choose one Enemy in Lucien's Location. Until the end of his turn, Lucien's Attacks against it gain +2 Attack. After each such Attack, he may Move to a connected revealed Location and back without spending Actions.

cards.name: Perfect Finale
cards.rules: Move through up to 2 connected revealed Locations. During this movement, make one Attack with +3 Attack against up to 3 different Enemies you enter a Location with. Limit 1 per Quest.

cards.name: Spirit Bolt
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.

cards.name: Storm Spirit
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.

cards.name: Thorn Spirit
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Spirit Flame
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.

cards.name: Totemic Strike
cards.rules: Make an Attack. If Asha's Spirit Totem is in her Location, this Attack gains +2 Attack.

cards.name: Thunder Circle
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in Asha's Location.

cards.name: Ancestral Wrath
cards.rules: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If a Hero in the target's Location has a beneficial Status Effect, gain +1 additional Attack.

cards.name: Call the Storm
cards.rules: Choose one Location within 2 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy there.

cards.name: Place Spirit Totem
cards.rules: Place a Spirit Totem in Asha's Location, up to her maximum.

cards.name: Healing Spirit
cards.rules: One Hero in Asha's Location recovers 2 Health.

cards.name: Ancestor's Blessing
cards.rules: One Hero in Asha's Location gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.

cards.name: Cleansing Smoke
cards.rules: Remove one harmful Status Effect from a Hero in Asha's Location.

cards.name: Spirit Walk
cards.rules: Move to a connected revealed Location. If it contains Asha's Spirit Totem, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Totem Recall
cards.rules: Move one of Asha's Spirit Totems within 2 connections to Asha's Location.

cards.name: Protective Ancestor
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in Asha's Location would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0.

cards.name: Spirit Warning
cards.rules: Play when a Hero in Asha's Location or a connected Location is targeted by an Enemy Attack. That Hero gains +1 Armor for the triggering Attack.

cards.name: Totemic Pulse
cards.rules: Asha and each Hero in a Location containing one of her Spirit Totems recover 1 Health.

cards.name: Spirit Snare
cards.rules: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.

cards.name: Grand Totem
cards.rules: Place a Spirit Totem in Asha's Location, even if this temporarily exceeds her maximum by 1. Heroes there gain Inspired until the end of their next turn.

cards.name: Call of the Ancestors
cards.rules: Heroes in Asha's Location and each connected revealed Location recover 2 Health and gain Inspired until the end of their next turn. Enemies there gain Weakened until the end of their next activation. Limit 1 per Quest.
